primary_display_name_zh: 盖乌斯·卡西乌斯·朗基努斯

death.conversion_note: suicide after First Battle of Philippi

short_description_zh: 罗马共和国末期元老、将领。凯撒刺杀行动的主要策划者，伊壁鸠鲁派哲学家。腓立比战役后自杀。
short_description_en: Late Roman Republic senator and general. Leading instigator of Julius Caesar's assassination. Epicurean philosopher. Committed suicide after the Battle of Philippi.
review_note: Batch 4 ai_collected_unreviewed. Generated from Plutarch, Appian, Cassius Dio, Cicero's letters, and modern scholarship (Momigliano 1941, Sedley 1997).
